title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, Tenure
table_id: ACS 2025 1-year, B25003; percent margins from Data Profile DP04 (lines DP04_0046P and DP04_0047P)
geography: 50 states and DC, with a United States row (code US)
universe_or_base: Occupied housing units (households), by whether the household owns or rents its home
unit: households in housing units, with 90 percent margins of error; owner_pct and renter_pct are computed by the studio from the counts and stored to four decimals, so a chart rounds once; households_moe is the published margin of the households total (B25003_001M); owner_pct_moe_dp04 and renter_pct_moe_dp04 are the shares’ 90 percent margins in percentage points as the Bureau publishes them in DP04, to one decimal; owner_pct_moe_formula and renter_pct_moe_formula are the studio’s check, computed by the Bureau’s formula for a proportion and stored to four decimals
qualification: Survey estimates; shares near 50 percent should be compared using the margins of error before a chart calls a state mostly renters or mostly owners

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

owner_pct.description: owners as a percent of households, computed

renter_pct.description: renters as a percent of households, computed

households_moe.description: 90 percent margin of error of the households total (B25003_001M), as published

owner_pct_moe_formula.description: the studio’s check, printed nowhere (data lead ruling RF-11a): 90 percent margin of error of owner_pct by the Census Bureau’s formula for a proportion

renter_pct_moe_formula.description: the studio’s check, printed nowhere (data lead ruling RF-11a): 90 percent margin of error of renter_pct by the Census Bureau’s formula for a proportion

owner_pct_moe_dp04.description: 90 percent margin of error of the owner share as the Census Bureau publishes it in Data Profile DP04 (DP04_0046PM); the margin a chart prints

renter_pct_moe_dp04.description: 90 percent margin of error of the renter share as the Census Bureau publishes it in Data Profile DP04 (DP04_0047PM); the margin a chart prints

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, tenure, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; shares computed by Oath & Action from the table’s counts.

source_line_variants.with_dp04_margin: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, tenure, with margins of error from Data Profile DP04, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11 and 12, 2026. Survey estimates; shares computed by Oath & Action from the table’s counts; margins of error at 90 percent as the Bureau publishes them in DP04.

notes: Margins of the shares (statistics review S5; data lead rulings RF-11 and RF-11a), November 12, 2026. The Bureau publishes the shares’ margins in Data Profile DP04 of the same ACS 2025 1-year release (DP04_0046PM and DP04_0047PM, read from its API; 0.2 to 1.7 points for renters), and a chart prints those: the District of Columbia’s renter share, 61.9 percent, carries 1.5 points. Every DP04 share equals this file’s share rounded to one decimal. households_moe is B25003_001M, read from the same API call that returned every count and count margin in this file unchanged. The *_formula columns follow formula (6) for a proportion in the Census Bureau’s "Understanding and Using American Community Survey Data: What All Data Users Need to Know" (2020), chapter 8, with its ratio form only where the term under the root is negative; they run up to 0.32 points from DP04’s (Maine’s owners, 0.68 against 1.0) and are the studio’s check, printed nowhere (RF-11a).
